test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Preeti starts from point A and drives 7 km towards South. From here, she takes a left turn and drives 9 km. She then takes a final left turn and drives 7 km to reach point B. How far should Preeti drive to reach point A from point B?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) Preeti starts from point A and drives 7 km towards South.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70fb658b7de687090741cd0398bbdfd819569fd54b05ad65f4394f62f6e60ce2.png] 

2) From here, she takes a left turn and drives 9 km. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a4c27055a4cfc3808a1748b8a9e0c0f021cf1efd261ca1a308edfe7a6bcf6e41.png] 

3) She then takes a final left turn and drives 7 km to reach point B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8380d844c7a3815785aceb2d82c764793d8950c2206561bf04e25bee0384a69e.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39ae726afcef904b0cac18f1133beb93ca30d22b875927929c212e62ea093fec.png] 

Here, we can see that she needs to drive 9 km to reach point A from point B.

Hence, the correct answer is **"9 km"**.
